text:
Situation: Sugammadex 100 mg/mL 5 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 100 vials (30.7 days at 3.3 vials/day). Corvale General holds 61 vials (14.5 days at 4.2 vials/day). The labeled manufacturer for NDC 00006542315 is Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC with manufacturing at MSD SUB MERCK.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show sugammadex is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. No shortage exists per FDA. Proactive sourcing from alternate manufacturers not on the shortage list will protect supply if Merck allocation changes.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Aspiro Pharma Limited, VAI 2023-08-11) — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Inc. (Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited-FTO9, VAI 2024-05-17) — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Somerset Therapeutics, LLC (Solupharm Pharmazeutische Erzeugnisse GmbH, VAI 2022-07-29) — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Accord Healthcare Inc. and B. Braun Medical Inc. for formulary addition — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
